description: Fronius Primo GEN24 and Symo GEN24 (Plus) inverters through SunSpec: integer inverter model (101-103) with scale factors, nameplate, settings, status, controls, multiple MPPT (including the battery inputs) and basic storage control
source: Fronius GEN24 Modbus TCP & RTU operating instructions 42,0410,2649 (034-28092026) and the GEN24 Modbus register maps (Int&SF storage ROW, version 1.2.7-2)

sources.title: Fronius GEN24 Modbus TCP & RTU
sources.note: addressing, device IDs, models, scale factors

sources.title: GEN24 Modbus API external docs (Gen24_Primo_Symo_Inverter_Register_Map_Int&SF_storage_ROW.xlsx)
sources.note: Register map workbook, Complete Map sheet

notes: Modbus TCP (unit id 1, port 502) or Modbus RTU (slave id set in the inverter web interface, 9600 bps by default). Functions 03, 06 and 16.
Addresses are the register numbers printed in the manual (1-based): the first register, 40001, is sent on the wire as 40000.

This is the integer setting (SunSpec models 101-103); the float setting (111-113) uses different register positions and is not covered. The register positions depend on the model type and on the device: find the model by its ID register and use offsets, as the manual advises.

Scale factors are registers of their own: a value is its register times 10 to the power of the matching scale factor. Values the device cannot provide read as the unavailable value of the type (0xFFFF, -32768, 0xFFFFFFFF).

The workbook also exists for the US (storage_US), without storage and for the Verto, Tauro and Argeno inverters, each with its own map; those are not covered. The SunSpec 7xx models of the Primo GEN24 208-240 3.8-10.0 kW are described in the manual but not listed here.
Writing control registers needs 'Inverter control via Modbus' enabled in the web interface.
Written from the manufacturer's documents; not tested on a device.
